size_distribution.note: clean bimodal gap: corpus <=432 atoms, production >=2880 atoms

problem: SIMPLE-NN uses a single fixed batch_size; historical 32 would give worst-case batches of 32 x 3000 = 96,000 atoms (features + dG/dR derivative arrays) -> OOM risk on the 112 production cells.

primary_plan.rationale: bounds peak batch memory to ~12k atoms (~0.9 GB features est.), fits a >=16 GB GPU; stock SIMPLE-NN, no core change
primary_plan.throughput_note: corpus batches are small (5440/4 ~ 1360 batches/epoch) -> slower than bs=32 but acceptable

alternative_if_throughput_too_slow.scheme: two size-shards: corpus (batch_size 32) + production (batch_size 2), via a size-aware batch sampler or two train_list groups
alternative_if_throughput_too_slow.cost: needs a custom sampler or two-phase epoch; still no SIMPLE-NN core modification (sampler is external)
alternative_if_throughput_too_slow.status: documented option; adopt only if bs=4 wall-time is impractical

labeling_feasibility.teacher_inference_max_cell: 3000 atoms — Allegro handles arbitrary size; single-point on ~3000-atom SiOx is routine on GPU (documented in prior C3 teacher run)
labeling_feasibility.preprocessing_memory: per-cell SF + dG/dR arrays for a 3000-atom cell are the peak preprocessing object; process production cells one at a time
